el.Cada clase integra asanas, respiración c: Each class brings together asanas, conscious breathing, Pranayamas, relaxation and meditation. The practices work the body as a whole (strength, mobility, flexibility, balance and body awareness) without losing sight of the mental and spiritual dimension of Yoga.
el.No es una clase de estiramiento ni una r: This is not a stretching class or a gym routine: it is a Yoga practice, with its own rhythm, its silence and its closing.
The whole body, not just a part of it.
el.Fuerza, movilidad, flexibilidad y equili: Strength, mobility, flexibility and balance. Asanas practiced with technique and with time, adapted to what each body can do that day.
el.Respiración consciente y Pranayamas como: Conscious breathing and Pranayamas as part of the class, not an add-on at the end.
el.Relajación y meditación para cerrar. Sal: Relaxation and meditation to close. You leave the practice with your nervous system in a different place from where it started.
